name: fpgod
description: FPGod — AI-powered financial planning application (monorepo root)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
